---
title: "Where does the ballast go, and how much?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
mp0 = mass_properties()
x_np = neutral_point(band=(0, 8), V=6.0)

SM = 0.10                            # specified above
x_cg = x_np - SM * c_w

x_b = np.linspace(0, x_le_w, 200)
m_b = ballast_for(x_cg, x_b, mp0)
nose, le = ballast_for(x_cg, 0.0, mp0), ballast_for(x_cg, x_le_w, mp0)

DIME = 2.268e-3                      # kg, a US dime, the plan's own ballast
dime = mass_properties(m_ballast=DIME, x_ballast=0.0)
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{nose*1e3:.2f}"` g]{.hero-value}
[on the nose, for the specified 10% MAC]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Station matters more than mass: the same margin costs
[`{python} f"{le*1e3:.2f}"` g]{.key} at the wing leading edge (@fig-ballast).
Unballasted the airframe is unstable, because tail surfaces on a long fuselage
pull the neutral point ahead of the structure's own centre of gravity. The
plan's dime is not enough here.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Specified
Asked of the user, 2026-08-27:

1. **Static margin: 10% MAC** — conventional for free flight.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Assumed
1. **Neutral-point fit band: α = 0–8°**, bracketing best L/D.
:::

```{python}
#| label: fig-ballast
#| fig-cap: "Ballast mass needed against the station it is taped to, from the nose back to the wing leading edge, for the specified 10% MAC. The dashed line marks the 2.27 g of the dime the plan calls for."
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))

ax.plot(x_b * 1e3, m_b * 1e3, label=f"static margin {SM:.0%} MAC")
ax.axhline(DIME * 1e3, ls="--", c="0.4", lw=1,
           label=f"a dime, {DIME*1e3:.2f} g")
ax.set_xlabel("ballast station [mm aft of the nose]")
ax.set_ylabel("ballast mass [g]")
ax.set_xlim(0, x_le_w * 1e3)
ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
